events.title: Pope Clement V suppresses the Knights Templar
events.description: Under pressure from Philip IV of France, Clement V issued the bull Vox in excelso at the Council of Vienne abolishing the Templars. Their property passed largely to the Hospitallers.
events.html: Under pressure from Philip IV of France, Clement V issued the bull Vox in excelso at the Council of Vienne abolishing the Templars. Their property passed largely to the Hospitallers.

events.title: Powhatan attack kills 347 Virginia colonists
events.description: Warriors under Opechancanough struck English settlements along the James River, killing about a quarter of the colony's population. The English responded with years of retaliatory war.
events.html: Warriors under Opechancanough struck English settlements along the James River, killing about a quarter of the colony's population. The English responded with years of retaliatory war.

events.title: Parliament passes the Stamp Act
events.description: The act taxed printed papers in the American colonies, from newspapers to playing cards. Colonists protested 'no taxation without representation', and Parliament repealed it the next year.
events.html: The act taxed printed papers in the American colonies, from newspapers to playing cards. Colonists protested 'no taxation without representation', and Parliament repealed it the next year.

events.title: Stephen Decatur killed in a duel
events.description: The naval hero of the Barbary Wars was mortally wounded by Commodore James Barron at Bladensburg, Maryland. His death strengthened public feeling against duelling.
events.html: The naval hero of the Barbary Wars was mortally wounded by Commodore James Barron at Bladensburg, Maryland. His death strengthened public feeling against duelling.

events.title: Lumière brothers show their first film
events.description: At a meeting in Paris, Louis and Auguste Lumière projected 'Workers Leaving the Lumière Factory' with their Cinématographe. Their first paying public screening followed in December.
events.html: At a meeting in Paris, Louis and Auguste Lumière projected 'Workers Leaving the Lumière Factory' with their Cinématographe. Their first paying public screening followed in December.

events.title: Arab League founded in Cairo
events.description: Egypt, Iraq, Transjordan, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia and Syria signed the pact founding the League of Arab States, with Yemen joining soon after. It now has 22 members.
